name: Aerosun Corporation
summary: Aerosun Corporation manufactures and sells special vehicles in China and internationally. The company offers nuclear equipment, nuclear waste treatment equipment, and military intelligent products; logistics and fuel support equipment, logistics engineering equipment, and municipal sanitation vehicles; and various types of refueling and aircraft refueling trucks, fuel transportation systems, emergency rescue vehicles, water transport/purification equipment, garbage collection vehicles, sewage suction/vacuuming vehicles, road cleaning vehicles, and other specialized vehicles.
